snippet.title: INSECTILE Monster Taming Direct 2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
This trailer originally aired during Monster Taming Direct 2025.

INSECTILE is a creature collector RPG where you piece bugs together to form your attacks! Assemble your party of cute bugs and synergize their puzzling shapes with their unique effects!

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3045270/Insectile/
